access: Pointing, placing, speech, sign or AAC

preparation.label: Print, cut and choose a support level
preparation.materials: Paper or card stock; optional laminate and hook-and-loop

teaching_steps.title: Read
teaching_steps.detail: Read the source book and review the four events.

teaching_steps.title: Order
teaching_steps.detail: Place each event under first, next, then or last.

teaching_steps.title: Retell
teaching_steps.detail: Use temporal words to explain the sequence.

scarborough.statement: Supports temporal language and knowledge of narrative event order.
